name: Coarena
description: 24-model API with a daily free allowance on its free models, no card.
overview: Coarena keeps 24 frontier and open models behind one key that answers on both OpenAI and Anthropic base URLs, so Codex, Claude Code and LangChain work unchanged. The free tier covers the models marked free, with Coarena paying for the compute: 30 requests a minute, two in flight, plus a per-account daily request limit set by the operator. Credits unlock the rest of the catalogue, and the limits endpoint reports today's usage.
free_access: Free models paid for by Coarena
OpenAI and Anthropic base URLs on one key
No card for a free key
notes: The daily request limit is per account and shown in GET /api/v1/limits.
